/*
================================================================================
模块 02 - 新手引导漏斗对比（繁体 CBT vs 新加坡 OBT1）
口径：以 new_role 圈定创角用户；引导事件通过 #distinct_id 回溯到创角设备，且仅统计创角当日。
      不使用引导事件自身的 #user_id/#account_id，二者在创角前可能为空或为临时值。
================================================================================
*/

WITH ScanConfig AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_start_date,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_end_date
),
UserBlacklist13 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
UserBlacklist18 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SingaporeUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT '1.小新繁体CBT' AS cohort_name, e."#user_id" AS user_id,
           e."#distinct_id" AS distinct_id, e."$part_date" AS role_date, 18 AS app_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN ScanConfig sc
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist18 ub ON e."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(sc.tw_start_date AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(sc.tw_end_date AS VARCHAR)
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
      AND e."#distinct_id" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

    UNION ALL

    SELECT '2.小新新加坡OBT1' AS cohort_name, e."#user_id" AS user_id,
           e."#distinct_id" AS distinct_id, e."$part_date" AS role_date, 13 AS app_id
    FROM ta.v_event_13 e
    INNER JOIN SingaporeUsers su ON e."#user_id" = su.user_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist13 ub ON e."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-14'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
      AND e."#distinct_id" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),
RoleGuideLogs AS (
    SELECT c.cohort_name, c.distinct_id, g.gamer_guide_id, g.gamer_skip
    FROM ta.v_event_18 g
    INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM CohortUsers WHERE app_id = 18) c
        ON g."#distinct_id" = c.distinct_id AND g."$part_date" = c.role_date
    WHERE g."$part_event" = 'gamer_guide'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.cohort_name, c.distinct_id, g.gamer_guide_id, g.gamer_skip
    FROM ta.v_event_13 g
    INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM CohortUsers WHERE app_id = 13) c
        ON g."#distinct_id" = c.distinct_id AND g."$part_date" = c.role_date
    WHERE g."$part_event" = 'gamer_guide'
),
CohortTotals AS (
    SELECT cohort_name, COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS total_reg_users
    FROM CohortUsers
    GROUP BY 1
),
GuideAgg AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        CAST(gamer_guide_id AS VARCHAR) AS guide_step_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS reach_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(gamer_skip AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 THEN distinct_id END) AS complete_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(gamer_skip AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN distinct_id END) AS skip_users
    FROM RoleGuideLogs
    WHERE gamer_guide_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
GuideDim AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(CAST("gamer_guide_id@gamer_guide_id" AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) AS guide_step_id,
        MIN(TRY_CAST("gamer_guide_id@extra_id" AS INTEGER)) AS step_order,
        MAX("gamer_guide_id@guide_name") AS guide_name
    FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18504
    GROUP BY 1
),
GuideResult AS (
    SELECT
        g.cohort_name,
        COALESCE(d.step_order, TRY_CAST(g.guide_step_id AS INTEGER)) AS step_order,
        g.guide_step_id,
        COALESCE(d.guide_name, '步骤ID_' || g.guide_step_id) AS guide_name,
        t.total_reg_users,
        g.reach_users,
        g.complete_users,
        g.skip_users,
        LAG(g.reach_users) OVER (
            PARTITION BY g.cohort_name
            ORDER BY COALESCE(d.step_order, TRY_CAST(g.guide_step_id AS INTEGER))
        ) AS previous_reach_users
    FROM GuideAgg g
    INNER JOIN CohortTotals t ON g.cohort_name = t.cohort_name
    LEFT JOIN GuideDim d ON g.guide_step_id = d.guide_step_id
)
SELECT
    cohort_name AS "对比组",
    step_order AS "步骤序号",
    guide_step_id AS "引导步骤ID",
    guide_name AS "引导步骤",
    total_reg_users AS "创角总人数",
    reach_users AS "到达人数",
    ROUND(reach_users * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_reg_users, 0), 2) AS "到达率(%)",
    GREATEST(COALESCE(previous_reach_users, reach_users) - reach_users, 0) AS "单步流失人数",
    ROUND(
        GREATEST(COALESCE(previous_reach_users, reach_users) - reach_users, 0) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(previous_reach_users, 0),
        2
    ) AS "单步流失率(%)",
    complete_users AS "正常完成人数",
    ROUND(complete_users * 100.0 / NULLIF(reach_users, 0), 2) AS "完成率(%)",
    skip_users AS "跳过人数",
    ROUND(skip_users * 100.0 / NULLIF(reach_users, 0), 2) AS "跳过率(%)"
FROM GuideResult
WHERE step_order NOT IN (17)
ORDER BY "对比组", "步骤序号";
